id: 47
title: Sea Spleenwort and Other Stories, The. By the author of “The Heir of Redclyffe.”
author-name: Charlotte Mary Yonge
publication-date: '1862'
genre: Fiction
publication-format: Book
publisher: Groombridge and Sons, 5, Paternoster Row, London.
serialization: Appeared originally in the Magnet Stories for Summer Days and Winter
  Nights; 8 vols., 1860-5.
---

This contained ‘The Sea Spleenwort’, ‘The Mice at Play’ and ‘The Strayed Falcon’. A number of other Magnet stories by others seem also to have been bound up in this way and published in Groombridge’s gift book series (in which Historical Dramas also appeared).
